No Strava needed: Upload a FIT, TCX, GPX, or CSV file straight from your watch or app for full analysis (GPS map, per-km splits, heart-rate zones, power). Works with Garmin, Coros, Polar, Suunto, Wahoo, and Apple Watch exports.

Supports Garmin, COROS, Polar, Suunto, Wahoo, Apple Watch (.fit, .tcx, .gpx, .csv)

Got a Garmin, Coros, or Apple Watch? Easiest path is to connect it to Strava once (Garmin Connect → Settings → Partner Apps, Coros app → Profile → Strava, Apple Health → Strava), then use Auto-sync above. Or log manually below if you prefer not to use Strava.
